name: hue
title: Hue
description: Philips Hue over the bridge's CLIP v2 API: rooms, lights and scenes at the root, a light or a room under the keys with its colour, brightness and temperature, sensors, automations and entertainment areas, a bar item for the home, and a guided pairing that finds the bridge and waits for its button.
author: pal

settings.label: Bridge
settings.description: The bridge's address, for a key kept in the keychain (below). Pairing from Set up Hue needs neither: it finds the bridge and keeps the key in pal's storage.

settings.label: Application key
settings.description: The hue-application-key for the bridge above, as a keychain: or env: reference. Set up Hue shows the key it made (c copies it); pasting it here moves it into the keychain.

settings.label: Certificate
settings.description: Off, every request is verified against Signify's root CA plus the certificate pinned at pairing. On for a bridge behind a proxy or a very old firmware whose certificate fails that.

settings.label: Transition
settings.description: How long a change from a row or a link takes on the lights; the view has its own, cycled with d.

settings.label: Main room
settings.description: The room whose colour the bar item's dot shows and whose scenes its popover lists. Empty: the room with most lights on.

settings.label: Bar scenes
settings.description: Scene names (or ids like scene:living-room/relax) listed in the bar item's popover, in this order. Empty: the main room's scenes.

settings.label: Timeout
settings.description: How long one request to the bridge may take before the row says it did not answer.

store.tagline: Every Hue light, room and scene, live, under the keys
features: Rooms and scenes at the root: `living room` and Enter toggles the room, `relax` and Enter plays the scene; the rows carry the room's colour as a tile and a scene's palette as a five-swatch strip

A light or a room under the keys: the big tile in its colour, brightness on the arrows and the digits, colour temperature along a warm-to-cool strip, hue and saturation on a colour plane, the presets, the room's scenes, the effects, apply to this light or the whole room, the transition length
Live: one event stream per bridge keeps the model current, so the rows and the bar follow a change made in the Hue app or on a switch without a request
Sensors: motion, temperature, light level, buttons and dials with their last event, batteries; automations enabled or disabled; entertainment areas started and stopped

The bar item: how many lights are on and the main room's colour as a dot; the popover is the home in reach: the rooms as colour tiles (a tap toggles, the chevron opens the room's lights with sliders), the scenes as swatch tiles on the digits, the sensors, everything on or off
Set up Hue finds the bridge (the cloud endpoint and mDNS), waits for its button with a countdown, pins its certificate and keeps the key; several bridges make one home

actions.title: Set brightness or temperature
actions.description: The bar's fields on a room or light row: a brightness in % (0 is off) and, where the light tunes white, a colour temperature in K; one PUT with the transition.

actions.title: Set up Hue
actions.description: Find a bridge, press its button, pair.

rooms.description: Every room and zone with its colour as a tile, how many of its lights are on and the brightness. Enter toggles it, cmd+Enter opens it under the keys.

keys.title: Open the room under the keys
Set the brightness (%) and colour temperature (K) typed in the bar

lights.description: Every light by room with its colour as a swatch, its brightness and temperature, and whether the bridge can reach it. Enter toggles, cmd+Enter opens it under the keys.

keys.title: Open the light under the keys
Set the brightness (%) and colour temperature (K) typed in the bar

scenes.description: Every scene by room as a five-swatch strip of its palette, the active one tagged; smart scenes too. Enter plays it, cmd+Enter plays it dynamically.

keys.title: Open the room under the keys

light.description: A light or a room under the keys: the tile in its colour, brightness on the arrows and digits, colour temperature and colour on strips, presets, the room's scenes, effects, the scope and the transition.

keys.title: Brightness (shift: big steps); hue on the colour row; choose on the other rows
Cooler or warmer; saturation on the colour row; the row above or below elsewhere
Toggle, or apply the chosen preset, scene or effect

setup.description: Pairing: the bridges found on the network, press-link with a countdown, the key kept and the certificate pinned.

keys.title: Forget a bridge, or stop a pairing

sensors.description: Motion, temperature, light level, buttons and dials with their last event, contact sensors, and each device's battery. Enter copies the reading, cmd+e enables or disables the sensor.

automations.description: The bridge's automations (wake up, go to sleep, timers, motion) with their status. Enter enables or disables one.

entertainment.description: Entertainment areas with their type and lights; Enter starts streaming, cmd+Enter stops it.

home.title: Home
home.description: How many lights are on, the main room's colour as a dot; the popover: the rooms as colour tiles that toggle on a tap, a room's lights inline with sliders, the scenes, the sensors, everything on or off. Hidden until a bridge is paired.

on.title: Lights on, the main room's colour as a dot

away.title: Bridge not answering, last state kept

item.tooltip: Hue: the bridge did not answer
